pages.title: The Hybrid
pages.text: The only class where stacking Spell Power gear makes your sword hit harder AND makes you tankier. Mana Shield scales with total Spell Power - the more arcane power, the more you can take.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$() - +40% HP cushion, no melee malus. The strongest pick.$(br)$(thing)Orc$() - +10% melee + attack speed = highest raw blade DPS.$(br)$(thing)Elf$() - +5% magic damage + speed for kiting.

pages.title: Offmeta
pages.text: $(thing)Faefolk$() - +30% magic damage and +10% mana regen for the spells, but Arcane Cleave reads spell power, not magic damage, and $(warn)-30% melee$() means raw blade strikes hit weakly. A skill-expression pick - high ceiling, painful floor.
